school.placeholderDetail: School logo and name appear after sign-in

home.title: Welcome to Campus TAB
home.body: This is the app shell. Screens are added phase by phase: school setup next, then dashboards, attendance, leave, marks, report cards and fees.

school.title: Find your school
school.subtitle: Enter the school code from your school's notice or ID card.
school.invalid: A school code uses letters, digits and dashes, for example SUNRISE-BPL.
school.notFound: No school uses this code. Check it with your school office.
school.activate: Activate a new school with a licence key

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to {{school}}.
signIn.loginHint: The one your school gave you.
signIn.parentLink: Parent? Sign in with a code sent to your phone

mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Campus TAB.
mfa.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step sign-in. Each works once.
mfa.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code

otp.title: Parent sign-in
otp.subtitle: We will send a 6-digit code to the phone number the school has for you.
otp.sent: If this number is registered, a code is on its way. It works for 5 minutes.
otp.again: Use a different number or send a new code
otp.passwordLink: Staff? Sign in with your password

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We will send a link to the email or phone on your account.
forgot.sent: If an account matches, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works once, for 30 minutes.

password.rules: At least 10 characters. Not your name, email or phone, and not a common password.
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
password.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with it now.

enrol.title: Set up two-step sign-in
enrol.subtitle: Your account needs a code from an authenticator app every time you sign in.
enrol.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
enrol.step2: Scan the QR code, or type the key into the app.
enrol.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enrol.codesIntro: These recovery codes are shown only once. Each one lets you sign in once if you lose your phone. Download or print them and keep them somewhere safe.
enrol.savedConfirm: I have saved my recovery codes somewhere safe.
enrol.fileNote: Each code works once. Keep this file private.

activate.title: Activate your school
activate.subtitle: Enter the licence key Campus TAB gave your school. A code goes to the school's registered email and phone.
activate.chiefSubtitle: Create the Chief Admin account for {{school}}.

errors.loginRequired: Enter your email, phone or login name.

apiErrors.sign_in_failed: Those details didn't work, or there were too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes or ask your Principal.
apiErrors.console_sign_in_failed: Those details didn't work, or there were too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes.
apiErrors.mfa_code_invalid: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try again.
apiErrors.mfa_challenge_expired: The time for entering the code has run out. Sign in again.
apiErrors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
apiErrors.otp_expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
apiErrors.otp_locked: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
apiErrors.otp_rate_limited: Too many codes sent. Try again in a few minutes.
apiErrors.password_link_invalid: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
apiErrors.licence_key_invalid: A licence key looks like CTAB-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
apiErrors.licence_not_found: This licence key is not recognised. Check it and try again.
apiErrors.licence_already_activated: This licence key has already been used. The Chief Admin signs in with their own password.
apiErrors.licence_revoked: This licence key has been withdrawn. Contact Campus TAB support.
apiErrors.licence_expired: This licence has expired. Contact Campus TAB support to renew it.
apiErrors.step_up_required: Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm this.
apiErrors.console_browser_only: The platform console works only in the Campus TAB web app.
apiErrors.seat_limit_reached: The licence has no student seats left. Ask the Chief Admin to contact Campus TAB to add seats.
apiErrors.network: We couldn't reach Campus TAB. Check your connection and try again.
apiErrors.renewal_not_later: A renewal must end later than the current last valid day.
apiErrors.note_required: A correction needs a note saying what it corrects.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.body: For safety you will be signed out in {{seconds}} seconds without use.

ended.title: Sign in again
ended.body: You were signed out after a time without use. Sign in to carry on where you were.
ended.revoked: You were signed out on this device. Sign in to carry on.
ended.kept: What you typed on this page is kept.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.subtitle: Every browser and app signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise.

stepUp.body: This is a sensitive action. Enter a fresh code from your authenticator app to confirm it.

console.enrolSubtitle: Platform accounts must use an authenticator app at every sign-in.

signIn.title: Platform console
signIn.subtitle: For the Campus TAB team only. Sign in with your password and authenticator code.

schools.title: Schools
schools.codeHint: Letters, digits and dashes, for example SUNRISE-BPL. People type it at sign-in.
schools.name: School name
schools.contactHint: The activation code, and any Chief recovery code, go to this email and phone.

licence.title: Licence
licence.validToHint: Leave empty for one year from today.
licence.keyOnce: This key is shown only once and is not stored. Copy it now and give it to the school's contact.
licence.keyNext: The school opens Campus TAB, picks "Activate a new school" and enters this key. School code: {{school}}.
licence.revokeWarning: The school loses access at once. Its data stays, and a new licence can be issued later.
licence.typeCode: Type the school code {{code}} to confirm
licence.renewIntro: The licence now ends on {{date}}. Choose a later last valid day. It takes effect at once and is recorded in the school's audit log too.

recovery.title: Sole Chief Admin recovery
recovery.intro: Only when the school has exactly one Chief Admin who has lost both the authenticator and the recovery codes. A code goes to the school's registered contact; the school reads it to you. It only resets two-step sign-in: the Chief sets up a new authenticator at the next sign-in. It never sets or shows a password, and the school sees it in its audit log.
recovery.start: Send recovery code to the school
recovery.sent: A code was sent to {{to}} for {{chief}}. Ask the school to read it to you.
recovery.reason: Why, and how the school proved who they are
recovery.reasonHint: At least 20 characters. The school sees this.
recovery.done: Done. The Chief signs in with their own password and sets up a new authenticator.

usage.title: Usage
usage.computed: Worked out inside the school {{when}}. Numbers only.
usage.notYet: Not worked out yet. It runs every 15 minutes, or use Refresh numbers.

security.title: Security overview
security.intro: Counts only, with no names or content. The details are in the school's own audit log, which needs a support grant from the Chief Admin.

payments.title: Payments
payments.appendOnly: Payments cannot be changed. To put a mistake right, record a correction with a minus amount and a note.
payments.amountHint: Use a minus amount for a correction; a correction needs a note.

grants.title: Support grants
grants.intro: Time-boxed access the Chief Admin has given our team. Without an active grant we cannot open the school's data.
grants.none: No support grants in the last 90 days.

alerts.title: Security alerts
alerts.intro: Raised when a count at a school jumps, such as a burst of failed sign-ins. Counts only; the details stay in the school's own audit log.

students.title: Students
students.admitIntro: Enter the student's details and at least one guardian. You can add more details on the profile later.
students.empty: No students to show here yet.
students.setupCodesLink: Student sign-in codes for this class
students.seatsWarning: The licence is nearly full. Ask the Chief Admin to add seats in time.

form.guardianIntro: A guardian's mobile number lets them sign in to the parent app later. Brothers and sisters with the same guardian phone share one parent login.
form.name: Full name
form.rollInvalid: A roll number is a whole number up to 999.
form.phoneInvalid: Enter a mobile number with country code, for example +919800000000.

duplicate.body: A student with the same name, date of birth and guardian phone already exists (admission no. {{admission}}). Check it is not the same child.

profile.readOnly: You can view this profile but not change it.
profile.admissionFixed: The admission number does not change.
profile.classTeacherNote: A class teacher can change only the roll number and the class's own columns; the office changes the rest.

guardians.name: Guardian name
guardians.parentLoginIntro: Parents sign in with a one-time code sent by SMS to the guardian's mobile number; there is no password. Brothers and sisters who share a guardian share one parent login, so one sign-in shows all the children.

custom.empty: No custom fields apply to this student.
custom.noneFillable: You can view these fields but not fill them.
custom.sensitiveHint: A value is saved but hidden. Type a new value only to replace it.

ids.aadhaarHint: Full Aadhaar numbers are never stored. Enter only the last four digits.
ids.aadhaarInvalid: Enter exactly four digits, or leave it empty.
ids.consentIntro: PEN and APAAR are kept only with the guardian's consent. Tick the consent first, then enter the number.

consent.pen: The guardian consents to keeping the PEN
consent.apaar: The guardian consents to keeping the APAAR ID
consent.photo_public: The guardian consents to the student's photo being shown publicly
consent.third_party_sharing: The guardian consents to sharing details with third parties

ids.officeOnly: Only the office can see and change ID numbers.

staff.title: Staff
staff.draftExplain: This sends a draft to the Principal. The account is created only when the Principal approves it.
staff.empty: No staff to show here yet.
staff.rejectReason: Reason (the person who drafted it sees this)
staff.deactivateBody: They lose access at once and every device is signed out. Their record and history are kept.

form.name: Full name
form.contactHint: The password setup link goes to the email, else by SMS. With neither, you get a setup code to hand over.

setupCode.title: Password setup code
setupCode.warning: Give this code to the person so they can set their own password. It is shown only once and is not shown again.

imports.intro: Fill the template, upload it, check the report, then import. Nothing is created until you press Import.

templateHint.students: One row per student. Keep the column names. Your custom columns are included.
templateHint.staff: One row per staff member. Keep the column names.

imports.fileHint: An .xlsx or .csv file up to 10 MB.
imports.failed: The import stopped. Upload the file again.
imports.seatNumbers: Licence: {{limit}} seats · used {{used}} · this file adds {{adding}} · {{available}} available

setupCodes.title: Student sign-in codes: {{section}}
setupCodes.intro: Students sign in with their own login name and a password they set themselves. Each student gets a one-time setup code to set it.
setupCodes.how1: Print the sheet and give each student their own line.
setupCodes.how2: The student opens Campus TAB, enters the school code, their login name and the setup code, then sets a password.
setupCodes.how3: Making new codes cancels any earlier codes for this class.
setupCodes.loginOff: Student sign-in is switched off for this school. The Chief Admin can switch student sign-in on in the school settings.
setupCodes.once: These codes are shown only once and expire after {{hours}} hours. Print them now.
setupCodes.noStudents: No active students in this section.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.intro: Add your own columns to student and staff records. You see and change only the fields at your level and scope.

form.scopeHint: Only the places you look after are offered.
form.entitySectionHint: A class or subject column belongs to the student's place in the class this year.
form.subjectTeachers: Also show to subject teachers of this class
form.noAadhaar: Aadhaar and bank account fields cannot be created.

setup.title: School setup
setup.intro: Set up the school step by step. Each step saves as you go, so you can stop and come back later.

profile.title: School profile and logo
profile.intro: The name and logo appear on every screen, report and receipt.
profile.noAccess: Only the Chief Admin can change the school profile. Go on to the next step.
profile.name: School name
profile.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 512 KB.
profile.logoType: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
profile.logoSize: The logo must be 512 KB or smaller.

year.title: Academic year
year.intro: Classes, sections and students belong to the current year.
year.name: Year

classes.title: Classes and sections
classes.intro: Add each class of the current year with its sections.
classes.name: Class name
classes.sectionsHint: Separated by commas, like A, B, C

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Add staff one by one, or import them from a spreadsheet.
staff.classTeachersIntro: Choose a class teacher for each section.
staff.subjectTeachersIntro: Who teaches which subject in which section.
staff.subject: Subject
